##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 24 May 2026 at 11:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers the area and much of Europe, while low pressure covers the mid-Atlantic.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, but falling Variable 3 or less in the southeast of the area, becoming Variable 2 to 4 in all waters this evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight, falling smooth or slight this evening.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but with a risk of mist and fog patches at first.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less, settling Northerly 3 or 4 tomorrow evening.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but with a risk of mist patches at first.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in any mist.
